label: Existing e2e SDK tests
description: Run the SDK-level e2e provider tests that already live under tests/ once per Rust/Python environment variant, so a real end-to-end call proves parity instead of only a bridge-level comparison.

core/ocr.note: Live SDK-level litellm.ocr()/aocr() calls against real providers. LITELLM_USE_RUST_OCR toggles the Rust bridge, so the python/rust rows prove the same test suite passes on both paths. Requires provider credentials; partial because it does not yet cover every OCR provider litellm supports.

core/messages.note: No env-var Rust toggle exists yet for litellm.messages(); wire it here once dsh-messages gains one.

core/responses.note: No env-var Rust toggle exists yet for litellm.responses(); wire it here once one is added.

core/count_tokens.note: No existing e2e SDK test suite with a Rust toggle exists yet.
